model.label: Surface Elo
model.desc: Overall and per-surface ratings (hard, clay, grass) with K = a / (n + b)^c decaying in matches played, a fitted surface blend w (a match uses w x surface + (1 - w) x overall), a best-of-five sharpening, a pull towards 1500 after layoffs and entry ratings from the ranking. Every constant fitted on 2005-2019 walk-forward log-loss.

model.label: Serve/return model
model.desc: logit P(i holds v j) = baseline (surface, indoor, best of five, level) + s_i - r_j with per-surface deviations, fitted by penalised maximum likelihood on the exact probability of every observed set score (an exact dynamic programme over service games; the first server is unknown, so both orders are mixed), time-decayed. The WTA fit adds the official point and game statistics as binomial terms.

model.label: Chain-scale hold
model.desc: The hold probability whose i.i.d. point/game/set chain reproduces observed scorelines (used for pricing); the displayed calibrated hold adds the tour's offset learned from real WTA stats.

model.label: Match chain
model.desc: Exact Markov chain point -> game -> tiebreak -> set -> match from the two serve-point probabilities: win probability, set-score, total-games and game-handicap distributions, tiebreak and straight-sets probabilities; deciding-set rules by event and year (advantage, tiebreak to 7, to 10, at 12-12).

model.label: Model probability
model.desc: logit p = w_elo logit(Elo p) + w_sr logit(serve/return p), weights fitted on walk-forward predictions; the serve-point pair is then shifted so the chain returns p, with a small match-level dispersion for distributions.

model.label: Live win probability
model.desc: The same chain from the current score (sets, games, server, points); the serve-point probabilities are held at their pre-match values. Finished matches replay the most likely game order when only set scores are known (marked as reconstructed).

model.label: Leverage
model.desc: P(win | win the game) - P(win | lose it) before a game.

model.label: Excitement
model.desc: The sum of absolute win-probability changes along the match.

model.label: Comeback
model.desc: The winner's lowest win probability during the match.

model.label: Tournament simulation
model.desc: 20,000 Monte Carlo runs of the real bracket (round robin for the Finals) with results so far fixed and each remaining match priced by the model; the 'if she wins' odds are reweighted so they measure the match itself.

model.label: Season simulation
model.desc: The rest of the calendar played many times: entry probabilities by level and history, seeded draws, the real points tables and 52-week drops, the Finals round robin. Gives Finals qualification, year-end No. 1 and ranking distributions.

model.label: Draw difficulty
model.desc: Mean expected opponent Elo along the bracket path from the bracket recursion with Elo probabilities at the start of the event.

model.label: Markets
model.desc: Kalshi and Polymarket two-sided midpoints (spread <= 12c), de-vigged for fields; a field is shown only when enough runners are quoted. Closing bookmaker odds (Pinnacle, average) from tennis-data.co.uk, de-vigged multiplicatively.

model.label: Percentiles
model.desc: 100 = best among the season's qualified players (a matches floor scaled to the season played), reversed where lower is better; rates are shrunk towards the pool mean by a few pseudo-matches before placing. The surface view compares players with enough matches on that surface.

model.label: Backtest
model.desc: Walk-forward from 2010: ratings use only earlier results, the serve/return model is refitted monthly, blend weights come from earlier years; scored by log-loss and Brier against Pinnacle's de-vigged closing prices.

model.label: Match Charting Project
model.desc: Shot-by-shot records of selected matches by volunteers (Tennis Abstract), CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; style profiles derived here are shared under the same licence.
